_source: Hand-verified from ASX Appendix 4D + Half-year Financial Report (Mineral Resources Limited, half year ended 31 December 2025, filed 20 February 2026). All values AUD, scale=millions confirmed from '$M' column headers. Revenue verified from Appendix 4D page 1 ('Revenues from ordinary activities = 3,052') and income statement page 14 ('REVENUE = 3,052'). EBIT: 'PROFIT/(LOSS) FROM OPERATIONS = 1,031' (IS row 13, page 14) — before finance costs. np_attributable: 'Equity holders of the parent = 495' (IS row 27, page 14) — excludes 78M NCI. Cash-flow values verified from statement of cash flows page 17. capex: 'Payments for property, plant and equipment = (333)' (CF page 17). cash_end: 'Cash and cash equivalents at the end of the half-year = 638' (CF page 17). Shares outstanding verified from share capital note page 32 ('Balance at 31 December 2025 = 196,478,902' net of treasury shares). net_debt derived: total borrowings current (369) + non-current (5,147) = 5,516 minus cash_end (638) = 4,878 (Borrowings note page 30). Arithmetic cross-check: 412 (start) + 880 (ops) - 527 (investing) - 126 (financing) - 1 (FX) = 638 (cash_end).
